purpose: Decide the next source-backed backlog posture after S27-S32 closure without reopening blocked runtime, comparative metrics, collectors or dashboards.

s18_comparative_work_metrics.reason: Current five Work Observatory records are heterogeneous and not one reviewed stable comparison group.
s18_comparative_work_metrics.activation_requirement: At least five reviewed records sharing one stable comparison_group plus explicit comparison-validity and privacy review.

runtime_2_0_implementation.reason: ADR-016 keeps Runtime 2.0 as a strategic north-star and boundary review source, not an authorized implementation track.
runtime_2_0_implementation.activation_requirement: Later explicit boundary decision with repeated evidence proving a missing execution interface.

observatory_expansion.reason: S32 found existing Observatory surfaces sufficient for static read-only review and evidence accumulation.
observatory_expansion.activation_requirement: Repeated source-backed need for refinement or expansion; unavailable data must remain unavailable.

domain_pack_enforcement.reason: P19 has reusable guidance and two minimum packs, but executable enforcement is outside current scope.
domain_pack_enforcement.activation_requirement: Separate enforcement decision after repeated use of domain packs reveals a specific manual failure mode.

candidate_next_tracks.why: Domain packs are delivered as guidance; the next safe step is to observe whether they are usable before adding more packs or enforcement.
evidence_needed: at least one reviewed usage scenario

candidate_next_tracks.why: P8 remains partially delivered, but automation should wait until current manual surfaces show repeated prompt-hygiene or loading gaps.
Adding more packs before reviewing S28/S29 usage risks catalog growth without adoption evidence.

decision.rationale: After S27-S32, the safest substantive move is not more infrastructure or more dashboards; it is to test whether the delivered domain governance packs are understandable and useful as read-only/advisory guidance.
